description: This file defines common utility APIs and data structures for event dispatching and system event handling in a C-based project, including callback registration, event listening, and asynchronous event handling.

methods.name: EvtDispterInitCallbackList
methods.description: Initializes the callback list for event dispatching.

methods.name: EvtDispterRgstCbFuncToList
methods.description: Registers a callback function to the callback list for a specific event.

methods.name: EvtDispterCallFuncFromList
methods.description: Calls registered callback functions for a specific event from the list.

methods.name: EvtDispterClearCallbackList
methods.description: Clears all callback functions from the callback list.

methods.name: EvtDispterDestroyCallbackList
methods.description: Destroys the callback list after clearing it.

methods.name: EvtDispterRgstCallbackForEvent
methods.description: Registers callback functions for a specific event.

methods.name: EvtDispterCallFuncByEvent
methods.description: Invokes callback functions when a specific event is triggered.

methods.name: EvtDispterCheckEvtStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of a system event.

methods.name: EvtDispterHandleEventAsync
methods.description: Creates a thread to handle system events asynchronously.
